ruled_out_vectors.vector: Reentrancy via transfer handler callback during swap to read stale reserves
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: ENTERED bit in TstorishReentrancyGuardWithFlags remains set during transfer handler callback (line 70: currentGuard preserves ENTERED). All swap/liquidity entry points use nonReentrantWithFlags which checks ENTERED (line 80). No path to re-enter AMM state-changing functions during callback.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: N/A - structural argument, no code path exists

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Queued hook fee transfer clears custom flags enabling state desync via collectHookFeesByHook
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers clears custom flags (SWAP_GUARD_FLAG etc.) at AMMModule.sol:3190 but preserves ENTERED bit. collectHookFeesByHook (ModuleFeeCollection.sol:72-82) checks custom flags, and when they're cleared, it goes to direct _transferHookFeesByHook which follows checks-effects-interactions: storage.tokensOwed is decremented BEFORE safeTransfer (AMMModule.sol:3128-3129). No double-spend possible. No queue corruption: direct transfer path taken, not queue path.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Forged hook caller - call hook directly with fake pool identity
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All hook functions in AMMStandardHook check _requireCallerIsAMM() (AMMStandardHook.sol:940-943) which requires msg.sender == AMM (immutable). CLOBTransferHandler.ammHandleTransfer checks msg.sender == AMM (CLOBTransferHandler.sol:230-232). No way to call hooks directly.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Multi-swap within hook callback overwrites transient slot mid-swap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: ENTERED reentrancy guard prevents re-entering any swap function during hook callbacks. The transient slot DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT is only used in AMMStandardHook for direct swaps, and direct swaps cannot be re-entered.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Native ETH refund during hook triggers reentrancy to observe intermediate state
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _depositWrappedNativeAndRefundExcess (AMMModule.sol:3247-3260) refunds excess ETH via executor.call{value}. ENTERED bit prevents re-entering any nonReentrant function. 2300 gas not enforced (all gas forwarded) but reentrancy guard blocks exploitation.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: CLOB settlement callback reads AMM state before swap finalizes
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: In swap flow, pool reserves are updated (AMMModule.sol lines ~1420-1440 for swapByInput) BEFORE _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse which calls the transfer handler. CLOB handler reads no AMM state - it fills from its own order book. No stale read possible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Storage-slot collision via custom pool type or handler
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Pool types are called via regular call (not delegatecall): ILimitBreakAMMPoolType(poolType).swapByInput(...). Pool types have their own storage, cannot write to AMM diamond storage. Only core modules (AMMModule, ModuleAdmin, etc.) are delegatecalled.

SwapMath rounding consistently favors pool/LPs: amountIn rounded UP (swapper pays more), amountOut rounded DOWN (swapper gets less), feeAmount rounded UP. Each tiny swap loses the attacker value to rounding. CLOBHelper.calculateFixedInput rounds UP for makers at taker expense. No pool value leak path.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Permit mutation - replay with mutated unsigned fields (feeOnTop, recipient)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Known low-severity finding. feeOnTop is unsigned but limitAmount in the signed permit caps exposure. Executor can set feeOnTop but the signer's amountSpecified bounds total spend. No material extraction beyond what signer authorized.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: N/A - known finding, feeOnTop not signed in SWAP_TYPEHASH

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Stale transient storage (HOOK-001) composed with other vectors for higher extraction
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Known FP-001: DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT overwritten per-token by design. Used only for pricing bounds validation in afterSwap for direct swaps. Even if stale value used for price computation, the result only affects bound checking (revert vs allow). CP-004 already documents that afterSwap flag disabled = bounds bypass. No extraction path beyond known Low findings.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: N/A - known pattern FP-001 and CP-004

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan callback observes stale state from another module
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Flash loan uses balance snapshots before/after (AMMModule.sol:3308-3315). FLASHLOAN_GUARD_FLAG prevents swap/liquidity during callback. Balance validation after callback ensures exact repayment. No stale state observable - balanceOf calls are real-time.

theft_theses.thesis: Re-enter AMM during queued hook fee transfer (custom flags cleared, token callback) to extract double hook fees
Compose HOOK-001 stale transient storage with pricing bounds bypass to execute swap at manipulated price
Flash loan inside hook callback to manipulate reserves observed by view functions, then arbitrage
